posts.text: Picking an RCS platform for your store: Klaviyo is GA in 11 countries (US, UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, PL, AT, SE, NO, DK), built on a Google partnership. Postscript and Yotpo are still in private beta. Attentive claims first-to-market and a CTIA board seat. If texting matters this year, that gap is real.
